quote.text: selfishness; both of them will do you harm. When you start to lose your temper, remember: There’s nothing manly about rage. It’s courtesy and kindness that define a human being—and a man. That’s who possesses strength and nerves and guts, not the angry whiners.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Model calmness for your children by showing that true strength comes from practicing kindness rather than giving in to anger.
    • Use moments of frustration as teaching opportunities to demonstrate self-control and emphasize empathy in the household.
  • Leadership
    • Lead by example—cultivate courtesy and compassion, as these qualities inspire trust and respect among your team.
    • Recognize that temper and selfishness can erode unity; instead, choose thoughtful responses that fortify your leadership and encourage collaboration.
  • Product Management
    • In the face of challenging feedback or setbacks, maintain composure; thoughtful, courteous dialogue fosters innovation and resilient solutions.
    • Embrace patience and empathy when navigating team dynamics and customer needs, reinforcing that strength lies in balanced, measured actions rather than reactive anger.
